steps.title: Configure App Meta and Package Names
steps.description: Establish package namespace 'com.strictstudymode.app' and standard build parameters for modern Android target 34.

steps.title: Set Up Android Build Configuration
steps.description: Create build.gradle specifying compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, Java 1.8 compiler levels, and zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Declare permissions for PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE. Define activity entrypoints and service components with specialUse type for background monitoring.

steps.title: Define Custom Drawables and Styling Resources
steps.description: Create custom visual elements including rounded button states, input text fields, and white clean card containers to deliver a premium user interface without adding Google Material libraries.

steps.title: Design Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Construct activity_main.xml featuring custom status cards, countdown timer layout, strict mode controls, session duration selectors, and statistics overview widgets.

steps.title: Design App Blocker Layout
steps.description: Create activity_blocked_apps.xml with app list, search filter, and individual item layouts with toggles for restricting target applications.

steps.title: Design Weekly Schedule Layout
steps.description: Create activity_schedule.xml and row item layouts to allow users to add specific times of the day and repeat days for automatic distraction-blocking.

steps.title: Design Blocker Overlay screen
steps.description: Create activity_block_overlay.xml displaying strict warning alerts to intercept attention and prevent access to banned apps during study periods.

steps.title: Implement Background Monitor Service
steps.description: Develop StudyBlockerService.java which runs continuously as a foreground service, evaluates current schedule compliance, inspects package usage stats, and triggers intercept screens.

steps.title: Implement Main Control Panel
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java managing timer orchestration, permission checks, scheduling states, active monitoring toggles, and statistics storage using offline SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Implement App Chooser panel
steps.description: Develop BlockedAppsActivity.java displaying lists of all user-launchable programs with reactive filters and immediate SharedPreferences status sync.

steps.title: Implement Weekly Schedules Manager
steps.description: Develop ScheduleActivity.java providing timepicker-based creation, repeat-day selectors, and localized list maintenance to handle regular automatic blocking hours.

steps.title: Implement Blocker Overlay logic
steps.description: Develop BlockOverlayActivity.java to block back key, manage focus redirection, and redirect the user's attention back to their studies with high-impact motivational slogans.

steps.title: Building Strict Study Mode
steps.description: Compile raw code files and package metadata to build the complete native Android distraction-blocking study assistant.
